div.div:
The LLM never decides the roster, never overrides a labour rule, never approves.
It translates language into constraints and explains the solve. The solver decides.
Employee PII never reaches tier 2 — IDs only.
Trust KPI: manager override rate falling week over week.

Why this is the best pick
2 of VTI's 5 published case studies
are scheduling (10,000+ employees;
200+ stores).
Rostering is a solved OR problem —
the missing input was a slot-level
demand forecast. V03 supplies it.
